calls.title: Amazon/GrowthBook Partner Opptys
calls.summary: Growth Book is a rapidly growing 40-person company specializing in feature flags, experimentation, and product analytics, collaborating with major clients like Anthropic and Salesforce. The meeting emphasized the importance of establishing a deeper partnership with AWS to accelerate enterprise sales through co-selling programs. Doug Cherry discussed the critical Foundational Technical Review (FTR) process needed for official AWS partnership, which will unlock more opportunities. Plans for marketing at AWS re:Invent were also outlined, including participation in an open-source event. Communication will be streamlined using Slack with a focused channel for collaboration with AWS representatives to ensure effective progress on next steps, which include completing the FTR registration and utilizing case studies from lighthouse customers to enhance their joint value proposition.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, AWS Marketplace, Co-selling, Global Startup Program, Reinvent, Foundational Technical Review
